result.reason: The redline reaches and exceeds the fallback: affiliates remain covered without a notice requirement, and the licence is transferable to a successor in an M&A transaction. It also adds the preferred contractor-use right. The changes are targeted and preserve the Authorized Location, fee, object-code, and non-exclusive-use restrictions. It does not achieve the full preferred position because it adds no perpetual/irrevocable protection for paid-up licences or material-breach-only termination standard for subscriptions, but those protections are not required by the stated fallback.
